operations.description: Add threshold check and anomaly trigger invocation to BP_SeaAboveAnomalyController.

t3d:
Begin Object Class=/Script/BlueprintGraph.K2Node_CallFunction Name="CheckThreshold"
   FunctionReference=(MemberParent=Class'"/Script/Engine.KismetMathLibrary"',MemberName="GreaterEqual_DoubleDouble")
   NodePosX=0
   NodePosY=0
   NodeGuid={{GUID:gte}}
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:val_a}},PinName="A",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="real",PinType.PinSubCategory="double",DefaultValue="{{pulse_value}}",)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:val_b}},PinName="B",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="real",PinType.PinSubCategory="double",DefaultValue="{{threshold}}",)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:gte_out}},PinName="ReturnValue",Direction="EGPD_Output",PinType.PinCategory="bool",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,LinkedTo=(Branch_Pulse {{GUID:branch_cond}},),)
End Object
Begin Object Class=/Script/BlueprintGraph.K2Node_IfThenElse Name="Branch_Pulse"
   NodePosX=250
   NodePosY=0
   NodeGuid={{GUID:branch}}
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:branch_in}},PinName="execute",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="exec",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:branch_cond}},PinName="Condition",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="bool",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,LinkedTo=(CheckThreshold {{GUID:gte_out}},),)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:branch_then}},PinName="then",Direction="EGPD_Output",PinType.PinCategory="exec",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,LinkedTo=(TriggerAnomaly {{GUID:anomaly_in}},),)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:branch_else}},PinName="else",Direction="EGPD_Output",PinType.PinCategory="exec",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,)
End Object
Begin Object Class=/Script/BlueprintGraph.K2Node_CallFunction Name="TriggerAnomaly"
   FunctionReference=(MemberParent=Class'"{{anomaly_handler_class}}"',MemberName="{{anomaly_trigger_function}}")
   NodePosX=550
   NodePosY=0
   NodeGuid={{GUID:anomaly}}
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:anomaly_in}},PinName="execute",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="exec",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,LinkedTo=(Branch_Pulse {{GUID:branch_then}},),)
End Object
